approach: Add one Rust section to the producer brief, written only when the reading's class_of_work is "design". It quotes the reader's `Existing code:` assumptions as the reader's starting point, and tells the producer (a) to open those paths, (b) to search the repository itself for every further component, client, module, fake, test, doc section, config key, cache or limit the design builds, changes or depends on, (c) to put an "Existing code" section in the doc that names each path it will reuse or extend and says for each proposed component whether it already exists, and (d) to name the file and function behind every claim about what the code or host does and the source of every number. Root cause, as the code and history show it: the reader's check (`check_design_existing_code`, surveys.rs:1409, added 2026-11-01 per HISTORY.txt:1340) already forces the list and a reuse-or-extend criterion into every design reading, and `reading_sections` (briefs.rs:309-319) already prints both in the producer brief. But the list reaches the producer only as one line of `Assumptions:`, written from the request text, with no instruction to open it, carry it into the doc or search for what it leaves out, and nothing compares the doc's components with the repository. Nine of the 13 recorded cases are in jobs dated after the check, so the list alone did not prevent the class. To gate on class, `AcceptedReading` (briefs.rs:74) gets a `class_of_work` field copied from `Reading.class_of_work` in `AcceptedReading::new`. A design-only one-line rule is appended to the planner Report in planner.rs. No refusal rule is added and `check_design_existing_code` is untouched, so the share of past accepted readings newly refused is 0%. The change is one focused change in `crates/athena-context`, plus three compile-only edits in athena-core and the CHANGELOG and decision log entries.

decisions.choice: Name the root cause as 'the producer gets the inventory only as one assumption line and is never told to use it, to search the repository for what it omits, or to source its claims', and word the section to match ('the reader's starting point, not the full inventory; search for each further component yourself'). The doc comment keeps the reading's phrase: the producer was never told to use the inventory the reader already requires, and nothing compared the doc's components with the repository. Revision answer to finding 4.
decisions.reason: briefs.rs:315-323 prints every assumption and criterion into the producer brief, and surveys.rs:1409-1451 forces the `Existing code:` assumption and the criterion. HISTORY.txt:1340 dates that check to 2026-11-01, and 9 of the 13 jobs (20261104-192155-3b3e to 20261111-055238-5har) are later, so the failure recurred while the list was in the brief. What is missing is the instruction and the search, so the section carries them. It also states that the briefs's 'Recurring failure classes' section (briefs.rs:453-494) already quotes this class's newest prevention cut to 300 characters (CLASS_TEXT_CHARS) as data, not an instruction.
